title: GEO
content: Generative engine optimization (GEO) describes work intended to improve how content is represented in answers produced by generative AI systems.

meta.aliases:
Generative engine optimization
LLMO
AI SEO
meta.why: The label appears in research and in marketing briefs, where a project still needs a concrete outcome and a measurement method.
meta.example: A team replaces an unsupported claim with a sourced explanation and checks how its page is represented in repeated answer samples.
meta.check: Define the target questions, the expected reader benefit, and the measurement before selecting a technique.
meta.limitation: The GEO research paper evaluated a particular benchmark. Its reported gains do not forecast results for your site or for every current assistant.
meta.sources: Aggarwal et al.: Generative Engine Optimization | https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09735 | Research paper
